name: SVT pool marginal-price quote without an invariant
summary: SVT's unverified exchange contract priced buy() and sell() at its live USDT/SVT balance ratio read before the transfer, with no invariant for the trade's own effect. Two flash-loaned USDT buys pushed the ratio up, and selling the SVT back at the inflated quotes returned far more USDT than was paid in; the attacker sold its leftover SVT in two later transactions.
notes: The exchange is unverified and non-proxy; post-deployment owner calls set slots 3 and 6, which the exploit never read, so deployment is the reset. The deployer's earlier exchange versions used a test token, not real USDT.

Gross USDT depletion includes the ~120k USDT fee paid to the pool's fee wallet 0xf037a9f7, which left the drained pool. SVT, the protocol's own token, is not valued: the attacker's leftover SVT was sold back into the pool in the campaign and its proceeds are counted.
